name: SungEel HiTech Co., Ltd.
summary: SungEel HiTech Co., Ltd., based in South Korea, operates as a specialized firm dedicated to the reclamation of secondary batteries. Its primary functions involve the reprocessing of both industrial scrap and spent battery units. Leveraging an advanced process, the company extracts and produces crucial battery constituents from the resulting battery powder. These vital materials encompass nickel sulfate, cobalt sulfate, lithium carbonate, manganese sulfate, electrolytic nickel, and electrolytic copper, along with other related components. Established in 2000, SungEel HiTech maintains its main offices in Gunsan-si, South Korea.
